questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why women's designer handbags are so expensive nowadays
The trend for men carrying fashionable bags
How to choose a good briefcase
Famous fashion designers in Europe
questions.why: Rob says 'today we are discussing manbags', a trend for modern men.

questions.q: Where does Neil keep his things instead of in a manbag?
options: In a briefcase
In his car
In his pockets
In a woman's handbag
questions.why: Neil says 'I just stuff everything in my pockets'.

questions.q: Why doesn't Neil want to carry a manbag?
options: He is afraid people would laugh at him
He can't afford one
He thinks they are too heavy to carry around all day
His wife doesn't like them
questions.why: He says pockets are 'better than being a laughing stock, carrying a handbag around!'

questions.q: What does Neil question about the name 'manbag'?
options: Why it is so long
Why it is French
Why it isn't called a briefcase
Why a bag needs to have a gender
questions.why: Neil asks 'Why can't it just be a bag? Why does a bag have to have a gender?'

questions.q: Why does Rob say manbags are practical?
options: They are cheaper than briefcases
We now carry things like laptops, phones and lunch
They are waterproof
They last much longer than other bags and never get damaged
questions.why: Rob says what we carry has changed, 'you know laptops, mobiles, even our lunch'.

questions.q: According to Nick Carvell, why are some British men worried about carrying a bag?
options: Their idea of being manly is fragile
Bags are not sold in Britain
British weather is too wet
They prefer European styles of bags
questions.why: He says British men are tied up with an idea of masculinity 'so fragile' a bag can dent it.

questions.q: How does Nick Carvell compare British men with many European men?
options: European men worry more about masculinity
European men never carry bags
European men don't think about it as much
European men prefer backpacks
questions.why: He says British men think about it a lot 'in a way that I don't think a lot of European men do'.

questions.q: Has Rob convinced Neil by the end?
options: Yes, Neil is going to buy an expensive designer manbag
Yes, Neil will buy a 'murse'
Neil hasn't decided yet
No, Neil will keep using his backpack
questions.why: Neil says 'No, not really Rob' and that his trusty backpack is for him.
